cn_steps: 启用 `Subsonic`（运行时 `SubsonicCore`、`SubsonicEngine`，编辑器 `SubsonicEditor`，测试 `SubsonicEngineTest`）。
它是高级音频创作与播放系统（实验性，不保证向后兼容）。
用 Subsonic 搭建高级音频合成/播放逻辑。
属实验性音频系统；测试模块不进正式产品。
en_steps: Enable `Subsonic` (runtime `SubsonicCore`, `SubsonicEngine`, editor `SubsonicEditor`, tests `SubsonicEngineTest`).
It is an advanced audio authoring and playback system (experimental; backward compatibility not guaranteed).
Use Subsonic to build advanced audio synthesis/playback logic.
It is an experimental audio system; keep the test module out of production.
note_cn: 高级音频创作/播放系统（实验性）。

cn_steps: 启用 `Subtitles and Closed Captions`（运行时 `SubtitlesAndClosedCaptions`，编辑器 `SubtitlesAndClosedCaptionsEditor`）。
它是用于显示字幕与隐藏式字幕的独立插件。
配置字幕/CC 轨道并在 UI 中显示（多语言/无障碍）。
Game 模块依赖运行时模块；编辑器模块只进 Editor Target。
en_steps: Enable `Subtitles and Closed Captions` (runtime `SubtitlesAndClosedCaptions`, editor `SubtitlesAndClosedCaptionsEditor`).
It is a standalone plugin to display subtitles and closed captions.
Configure subtitle/CC tracks and display them in the UI (multilingual/accessibility).
Game modules depend on runtime modules; editor modules go to Editor targets only.
note_cn: 显示字幕与隐藏式字幕的独立插件。
note_en: A standalone plugin to show subtitles and closed captions.

cn_steps: 启用编辑器插件 `Subversion`（模块 `SubversionSourceControl`）并重启。
它提供 Subversion(SVN) 源码控制集成。
在 `Project Settings > Source Control` 选 Subversion 提供方，配置仓库。
这是编辑器/开发者插件，只进 Editor Target，不进 Shipping。
en_steps: Enable the editor plugin `Subversion` (module `SubversionSourceControl`) and restart.
It provides Subversion (SVN) source-control integration.
In `Project Settings > Source Control`, pick the Subversion provider and configure the repo.
It is an editor/developer plugin for Editor targets only; it does not ship.

cn_steps: 启用 `Sun Position Calculator`（模块 `SunPosition`）。
它根据纬度/经度与日期/时间计算太阳位置（方向光/天光）。
在关卡放 Sun Position 组件，设经纬度与时间，驱动太阳/月亮光照。
运行时模块；常用于室外光照与时间系统。
en_steps: Enable `Sun Position Calculator` (module `SunPosition`).
It computes sun position from latitude/longitude and date/time (directional/sky light).
Place a Sun Position component in the level, set lat/long and time to drive sun/moon lighting.
A runtime module; common for outdoor lighting and time-of-day systems.
note_cn: 按经纬度/日期时间计算太阳位置。
note_en: Computes sun position from latitude/longitude and date/time.

cn_steps: 启用 `SurfaceEffects`（模块 `SurfaceEffects`）。
它提供灵活的、上下文驱动的表面效果系统（按表面/上下文触发效果）。
在关卡/材质里配置表面效果，按命中/环境上下文触发反馈（如脚步/碰撞）。
运行时模块；用于上下文相关的表面反馈。
en_steps: Enable `SurfaceEffects` (module `SurfaceEffects`).
It provides a flexible, context-driven surface-effects system (trigger effects by surface/context).
Configure surface effects in levels/materials to trigger feedback by hit/environment context (e.g. footsteps/collisions).
A runtime module; for context-sensitive surface feedback.
note_cn: 灵活、上下文驱动的表面效果系统。

cn_steps: 启用 `SVG Importer`（运行时 `SVGImporter`，编辑器 `SVGImporterEditor`），属虚拟制片工具链。
它导入并处理 SVG 矢量文件（用于 UI/图形/动态图形）。
导入 .svg 生成可用资产，在 UI/Motion Design 里使用。
Game 模块依赖 `SVGImporter`；编辑器模块只进 Editor Target。
en_steps: Enable `SVG Importer` (runtime `SVGImporter`, editor `SVGImporterEditor`), part of the virtual production toolchain.
It imports and processes SVG vector files (for UI/graphics/motion graphics).
Import .svg to generate usable assets, used in UI/Motion Design.
Game modules depend on `SVGImporter`; editor modules go to Editor targets only.
note_cn: 导入/处理 SVG 矢量文件的插件。

cn_steps: 启用 `Switchboard`（模块 `SwitchboardCommon`，编辑器 `SwitchboardEditor`），属 Virtual Production。
它是总机（Switchboard）应用的启动器/安装程序（管理多机渲染设备）。
用 Switchboard 配置/启动/监听多机 nDisplay 渲染设备。
Game 模块依赖运行时模块；`SwitchboardEditor` 只进 Editor Target。
en_steps: Enable `Switchboard` (modules `SwitchboardCommon`, editor `SwitchboardEditor`), part of Virtual Production.
It is the launcher/installer for the Switchboard application (manages multi-machine render devices).
Use Switchboard to configure/launch/monitor multi-machine nDisplay render devices.
Game modules depend on runtime modules; `SwitchboardEditor` is Editor-target only.
note_cn: 总机（Switchboard）应用的启动器/安装程序。
note_en: A launcher/installer for the Switchboard application.

cn_steps: 启用 `Synthesis and DSP Effects`（运行时 `Synthesis`，编辑器 `SynthesisEditor`）。
它提供各种实时合成器、DSP 源与子混音效果。
在音频里用其合成器/DSP 节点做声音合成与效果处理。
Game 模块依赖 `Synthesis`；编辑器模块只进 Editor Target。
en_steps: Enable `Synthesis and DSP Effects` (runtime `Synthesis`, editor `SynthesisEditor`).
It provides various real-time synthesizers, DSP sources, and submix effects.
Use its synths/DSP nodes for sound synthesis and effect processing.
Game modules depend on `Synthesis`; editor modules go to Editor targets only.
note_cn: 实时合成器/DSP 源/子混音效果。

cn_steps: 启用 `Take Recorder Multi-User synchronization`（模块 `ConcertTakeRecorder`），属 Virtual Production。
它启用 Take Recorder 的可选加入式多用户同步（Concert 多端录制同步）。
在多用户会话里同步各端录制，保持时间一致。
运行时模块；配合 Take Recorder 与 Concert 使用。
en_steps: Enable `Take Recorder Multi-User synchronization` (module `ConcertTakeRecorder`), part of Virtual Production.
It enables opt-in multi-user synchronization for Take Recorder (Concert multi-end recording sync).
In a multi-user session, sync recording across endpoints with consistent time.
A runtime module; used with Take Recorder and Concert.
note_cn: Take Recorder 的多用户(Concert)录制同步。
note_en: Multi-user (Concert) recording sync for Take Recorder.

cn_steps: 启用 `Take Recorder`（模块 `TakesCore`、`TakeRecorder`、`TakeRecorderSources`、`TakeTrackRecorders`、`TakeMovieScene`、`CacheTrackRecorder`，编辑器 `TakeRecorderEditor` 等）。
它是为虚拟制片设计的录制、审查与回放工具集与界面。
用 Take Recorder 录制镜头/表演（多源），再回放审查。
Game 模块依赖运行时模块；`TakeRecorderEditor` 只进 Editor Target。
en_steps: Enable `Take Recorder` (modules `TakesCore`, `TakeRecorder`, `TakeRecorderSources`, `TakeTrackRecorders`, `TakeMovieScene`, `CacheTrackRecorder`, editor `TakeRecorderEditor`, etc.).
It is a tools/UI set designed for recording, reviewing, and playing back takes in virtual production.
Use Take Recorder to record shots/performances (multi-source) and play back for review.
Game modules depend on runtime modules; `TakeRecorderEditor` is Editor-target only.
note_cn: 虚拟制片用的录制/审查/回放工具集（Take Recorder）。
note_en: A recording/reviewing/playback toolset for virtual production (Take Recorder).

cn_steps: 启用 `TargetDeviceServices scripting library`（模块 `TargetDeviceServicesScripting`）。
它是一组蓝图函数，可通过脚本使用 `TargetDeviceServices` 模块。
在蓝图/脚本里调用这些函数管理目标设备服务。
属脚本/蓝图工具；编辑器或工具向。
en_steps: Enable `TargetDeviceServices scripting library` (module `TargetDeviceServicesScripting`).
It is a set of Blueprint functions to use the `TargetDeviceServices` module from scripts.
Call these functions from Blueprint/scripts to manage target device services.
It is a script/Blueprint utility; editor/tool-oriented.
note_cn: 脚本化使用 TargetDeviceServices 的蓝图函数库。
note_en: A Blueprint library to use TargetDeviceServices from scripts.

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental 的 `Targeting System`（模块 `TargetingSystem`）。
它是通用瞄准系统，用于游戏能力、瞄准辅助等（与 GAS 相关）。
用其组件/接口做目标选择、锁定与瞄准辅助。
Experimental：接口可能变动；常与 Gameplay Ability System 配合。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `Targeting System` (module `TargetingSystem`).
It is a generic targeting system for gameplay abilities, aim assist, etc. (GAS-related).
Use its components/interfaces for target selection, lock-on, and aim assist.
Experimental: contract may change; often used with the Gameplay Ability System.
note_cn: 通用瞄准系统（瞄准辅助/目标选择，GAS 相关）。
note_en: A generic targeting system (aim assist/target selection, GAS-related).

cn_steps: 启用 `TCP Messaging`（模块 `TcpMessaging`）。
它为消息子系统添加基于 TCP 连接的传输层，用于联网计算机/设备间收发消息。
配置 TCP 消息端点，跨进程/跨机通信。
运行时模块；属消息总线传输层。
en_steps: Enable `TCP Messaging` (module `TcpMessaging`).
It adds a TCP-based transport to the message subsystem for sending/receiving messages between networked computers/devices.
Configure TCP messaging endpoints for cross-process/cross-machine communication.
A runtime module; a message-bus transport.
note_cn: 消息子系统的 TCP 传输层（跨机收发消息）。
note_en: A TCP transport for the message subsystem (cross-machine messaging).

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental 的 `TechAudioTools`（运行时 `TechAudioTools`、`TechAudioToolsMetaSound`，编辑器 `TechAudioToolsMetaSoundEditor`）。
它是音频相关工具与实用程序的集合（含 MetaSound 工具）。
在音频设计/调试里用其工具辅助制作。
Experimental：接口可能变动；编辑器模块只进 Editor Target。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `TechAudioTools` (runtime `TechAudioTools`, `TechAudioToolsMetaSound`, editor `TechAudioToolsMetaSoundEditor`).
It is a collection of audio-related tools and utilities (including MetaSound tools).
Use its tools to assist audio design/debugging.
Experimental: contract may change; editor modules go to Editor targets only.
note_cn: 音频相关工具/实用程序集合（含 MetaSound 工具）。
note_en: A collection of audio tools/utilities (incl. MetaSound tools).

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental 的 `TEDS: Editor Data Storage Features`（模块 `TedsActorCompatibility`、`TedsOutliner`、`TedsPropertyEditor`、`TedsContentBrowser`、`TedsQueryStack` 等）。
它基于 TEDS（编辑器数据存储）构建实验性编辑器 UI 功能（大纲/属性/内容浏览器等）。
在编辑器里体验新的数据存储驱动的 UI 功能。
Experimental：接口可能变动；编辑器向，不进 Shipping。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `TEDS: Editor Data Storage Features` (modules `TedsActorCompatibility`, `TedsOutliner`, `TedsPropertyEditor`, `TedsContentBrowser`, `TedsQueryStack`, etc.).
It builds experimental editor UI features on TEDS (Editor Data Storage) — outliner/property/content browser, etc.
Try the new data-storage-driven UI features in the editor.
Experimental: contract may change; editor-oriented, does not ship.
note_cn: 基于 TEDS 数据存储的实验性编辑器 UI 功能。
note_en: Experimental editor UI features built on TEDS data storage.
